balls.text: Steyn gets a wicket off the last ball, full and he swung hard, looking to go over extra cover, but only got it as far as Jaggi there who went back to take the catch
another slower one, a touch short, but YK could not connect well, but managed to get it wide of deep midwicket for a couple
YK gets the boundary, full and wide outside off, YK throws his bat at it and gets a thick edge that flies fine to the third man boundary
slow and full on the stumps, Tiwary gets front leg out of the way and goes for the golf swing, just manages to get it over midwicket
143.8 kph full toss on off stump, cannot get under it and hits it away to long off
full and wide outside off stump, swings away in the air, he reaches out from the crease and misses
well bowled, tossed up and pitches in the blockhole, heaved along the ground to long off
another short one arrives, but comes slowly off the pitch, Manoj is in to the pull early and only manages the single to deep midwicket
very full and angled in, he hits it away to deep midwicket with a huge backlift
why would he need to do that, it was flighted outside off and he went down for the reverse sweep, got an inside edge on to the inner part of the thigh, that would have hurt as he went down
connects well this time, this one is short and he helps himself to a savage pull wide of deep midwicket
tossed up and YK looks to slog it over midwicket, but it turns and bounces past his swing
now it is Tiwary who gets the boundary, swings across the line and long on cannot stop the ball, running to his right, big over for Kolkata
129 kph fuller one on middle and leg, he had set himself up for the mow over wide long on, but managed to hit it along the ground to long on
another short one, YK was expecting it, it did not get up much above thigh height, he had it covered and pulled it wide of the deep midwicket fielder
stands in the crease and drives from the crease, on the bounce to extra cover
now comes the bouncer, but it takes off high and wide outside off stump
biff! YK gets one in the slot, pitched up and he scythes it past Steyn, mid off is surprisingly in the circle, and fails to stop it
makes room and looks to loft this one over mid off, goes to that man on the bounce
and looks to bash his first ball out of sight, has a big swing from the crease, but it turns away and he misses
Gautam goes this time, backs away and comes down the track for that lofted shot over the off side infield, but misses and the ball hits the middle stump, looked to be the one that slides straight on
comes down the track for the big shot but this one goes straight on and hits him on the pads
rocks back for the pull but finds deep midwicket with the shot
another one keeps low, turns in and he hits it away towards extra cover
slid in quicker through the air, goes straight on, but a touch short outside off and he rocks back to cut it in the gap between short third man and point
backs away for the cut, this one is bowled flatter and quicker, stays low and he guides it to short third man
pushed away off the front foot down the ground to long on
Manoj makes room outside leg and looks to run this one fine on the off side but misses as it bounces extra
goes down on the knee and sweeps a fuller one to deep square leg
turns down the leg side and that is a wide
neat work from Gautam, this one bounced extra and went straight on with the arm, but Gautam waited beside the line and dabbed it very fine on the off side
short and wide, cut away to backward point who has a throw at the stumps and concedes an overthrow needlessly
flighted full outside leg stump and turned past Ishant at square leg who labours after the ball and gives up the chase as the man from the deep gets to the ball
down the track, gets too close to the pitch of the ball, but still hits it wide of long off
and another one from Manoj, this one is a bit closer to him, and he slogs it over wide long on
this one is angled straight across the batsman who misses as he pushes at it
Tiwary with the slog sweep now, and makes good connection, picks it from outside off and sends it soaring in to the Kolkata night over deep midwicket
tossed up from round the stumps and defended off the front foot
poor delivery and Gautam capitalises, shuffles across and turns it wide of the man on the fine leg boundary
driven back to the bowler, who cannot field cleanly and concedes the run
another slower one, he backs away yet again, but cannot connect this time
Tiwary gets this one away, backs away outside leg, it was the slow offcutter, and he slammed it past backward point, in the air to the fielder's left. but too quick for him
dug in short and bounces above the batsman, called a wide for height
turned in front of square leg with soft hands, and that allows them to come back for the second
bowled on a length and angled in, pushed away on the leg side
gets off the mark with a tuck through square leg off the back foot
eep, Manoj gets himself in to a big tangle, it was darted in around off, he went back to dab it fine, but got it off the inner half near the stumps, and then overbalanced and went down on the ground
comes down the track and Duminy fires it wide of off stump, he pushes it away on the leg side
drops it a touch short and Kallis rocks back, and goes for the big forcing pull over deep midwicket but hits it straight to the man on the boundary, not the best of deliveries, but Kallis is gone
Kallis takes off in to Eden Gardens, goes down on the knee and slogs Duminy with the turn over deep midwicket, and that is also his 50
not much turn, but right on the stumps and whipped away to deep midwicket
too full, and Kallis gets the sweep wide of Steyn at fine leg who runs to his left,and tries to stop the ball with the boot but it trickles over the rope
this is a better approach, goes outside leg and slams it with the turn wide of long off
looks to do a Watson, goes down on the knee for the big slog sweep, but the ball is turning a long way, and goes well past off stump
angled across the left-hander who steers it behind point off the back foot
plays late from the crease, allowing for the turn, and guides it to short third man
skips down the track, Ojha shortens the length and he turns it to square leg
another short one, oh well, this one is helped away to sweeper cover for a single
cuts this one very late, takes off for the single even as short third man lurks close by, is rightly sent back
this time he dabs this one late behind point, they take a couple by the time sweeper cover runs across
another long hop, turning in from a very short length, Gambhir goes back and puts it away wide of sweeper cover
whipped away off the back foot to deep midwicket
dragged down  short, very short, in the bowler's half of the pitch, pulled away powerfully but straight to wide long on
one more sweep attempted, misses again, Ojha thinks about an appeal for a moment
this one goes straight on, the inside edge on to pad saves him as he stabs at it
this one turns away, but Kallis is ready, stands in the crease, opens the face and drives it between point and short third man
attempts the sweep again, this one is fired in on the pads, and he gets it away off the pads fine down the leg side
yet another sweep, this time Kallis misses, this one turned sharply away, Sangakkara had no chance, as the ball went between keeper and slip
turning away, he punches forcefully but cover dives and fields
this time he goes down on one knee and slogs this one from way outside off stump to deep midwicket
well bowled, it was the wrong 'un, he played outside the line of this tossed up ball and was struck on the pads, was it outside the line of off, Kallis survives the appeal
Kallis gets the sweep away all right, wide of fine leg for a couple
flighted and full outside off, driven with the turn to long on

the sweep consumes him in the end, again he went down on a knee, this one was much fuller than the last one, did not turn, went straight and struck him in front, umpire Koertzen takes ages to raise the finger, but does so finally, to Mishra's satisfaction
sharp turn for Mishra, he went for the sweep as it was angled in but then it spun wildly past the bat and ended up at slip
comes forward, Ojha sees that and drags the length short, he pushes it wide of cover
this time he gets it away, goes back and punches for a single to sweeper cover
looks to sweep from outside off stump, and misses
pushed away in front of point
ooh, Kallis went for the big off drive, the ball turned sharply past his bat, the keeper took off the bails, only he did not have the ball with him
flighted on middle stump, pushed away towards extra cover
turning away, a touch shortish and played away in front of point
the googly arrives, tosses up and comes back in, he didn't pick it and stabbed it away on the back foot
this time he gets across and paddles this fuller one to fine leg
lovely ball, pitches on a length on off, and turns away as he plays half-forward
full on the stumps, sweeps it away to deep square leg
tossed up, he comes forward and pushes it to sweeper cover
they take on short fine leg with the run, Bisla makes it in the end even as there is a direct hit
what a shot from Jacques Kallis! he has creamed this one off the back foot, on a length, some width outside off, and he smashes it past cover and point, as they say, no one moved
looks to take off over square leg with a big heave, but cannot connect with this one on the pads
Bisla succeeds in what he has been trying to do repeatedly, backs away, gets front leg out of the way, and slaps this one through extra cover
this one straightens around off stump, Kallis plonks it down with soft hands, opens the face of the bat, and takes a single in front of covers
stands in the crease and whacks this length ball wide of fine leg
good slower one, follows the batsman as he comes down the track, he misses, the keeper fails to collect on the bounce as well
116.2 kph length ball on the pads, he cannot put it away past midwicket
turned to short fine leg for a single
backs away and looks to carve this one through covers, gets too far from the ball and gets it off the bottom edge in to the off side
hammered down the ground, too full, on the stumps, in his slot and he lofts it back over the bowler's head
steered away to third man off the back foot
Kallis rocks back in the crease, this one is not far from off stump, but he slashes it with lovely timing, and it flies to third man
short but angled in on leg stump, he pulls it away to fine leg
the slower one from Ishant, moves away off the seam from a length, Kallis is squared up and gets it down to third man off a thick edge
this time he gets it past mid on, moves around in the crease and whips it away, mid on runs to his right and puts in the dive, but the ball beats him
shuffles outside off stump, and looks to turn this one through midwicket, but only gets it as far as mid on
bouncing from just short of a length, he stands tall and punches to covers
again Bisla backs away, and throws his bat at one that Steyn bowls outside off, misses by a mile
hurries in off a length, he goes back to defend down the track
Kallis gets off strike with a quick single to point

dropped Ishant Sharma at third man, Bisla backed away to carve this one over point, but it was the slower one, and he reached out to upper cut it to Ishant who made a mess of it while diving forward to grab at the ball
Steyn is steaming in, and Bisla is feeling the heat, this one takes off even on this pitch from just around a length, and somehow Bisla manages to keep it down
ripper, absolute ripper, Bisla had no clue about it, cut him in half as it moved in from short of a length, and Bisla ended up poking outside the line
another one keeps a bit low outside off, this time Kallis adjusts brilliantly, letting ti come on, standing in the crease and pushing it in to the gap at covers at the last instant
this one has more zip on it but is angled on the pads, Kallis misses out though, flicking straight to square leg
it is the second over, and the ball is already not rising more than a foot, fortunately for Kallis it was also a foot outside off, else he was in trouble
a touch short of a length and on the stumps, Kallis shuffles and defends with a straight bat
bowls this one on the pads, and Bisla puts it away to fine leg for a single, the way the crowd cheered that shot, he should have got six for it
gets this one to straighten and bounce outside off, Bisla pushes with an angled bat, and the thick edge beats the slip cordon and runs in to the third man boundary
fuller and angled in on the pads, he plays it out watchfully towards midwicket
now this one hurries through, skids off the surface, Kallis had set himself up for the pull, and ended up swinging over the ball on one leg as it went past him
Steyn gets some lift this time, put in a lot of effort on this one, and got it to get big on Kallis who hopped on his toes, and brought it down
lovely drive, there is not much bounce here, even as this one swings away on a length, Kallis can get front foot out and push it in the gap past cover
this one did not get up much, Steyn stares at the pitch, it moved away outside off and was left alone
Kallis is away to loud cheers, Steyn delivers one on his pads, and Kallis puts it away fine

Eoin Morgan with a superlative attempt on the long on boundary, it was swung hard from a fuller length, and looked headed for maximum before Morgan decided to get in the way and leaped high in the air one-handed, he even got a hand to the ball but could not hold on, toppling over the ropes in the end, Kolkata have a win that was more comfortable than the margin of nine runs
one more slower one outside off stump, but it is called a wide this time
fuller again but this time angled across Ishant who pushes it in the air to long off
Jaidev shatters Steyn's stumps and sets off on a big celebratory run, it was bowled fuller this time, and Steyn missed with the swing
110.4 kph slower one outside off on a length, well bowled, he had set himself up for the big one over midwicket, but was surprised by the lack of pace and pulled out of the shot in the end
117 kph delivery slanted across the batsman who looks to swing it away again but misses it completely
goes for maximum over deep midwicket, but gets it on the bounce to wide long on
hit down the ground, but only for a single to long on
what is going on? it was a very slow one from short of a length, he walked away outside off to scoop it over short fine leg, missed, and Bisla fumbled the take as well
another one in the blockhole around off stump, squeezed away towards extra cover
yorker outside off stump, squeezed away towards point
lovely extra cover drive, stands tall in the crease and hammers it past mid off
gives a slower one outside off everything, but all he gets is an inside edge past the stumps to short fine leg
swung down to Morgan at long on again, this time he'll get only a run
high full toss and he gets it away straight down the ground where Morgan at long on fails to stop it in the end
goes for the big swing over midwicket, but misses out another short slow one
how is that a wide, it was dug in very slow, and looped away outside off stump, and on the bouncer to the keeper, called a wide
squares him up with one that kicks away from a length, he gets it off a thick edge through point
angled wide of the right-hander who drives it to sweeper cover

would you believe it, it is Jacques Kallis, there is no getting away for him, Teja went down on a knee for the big heave-ho over midwicket, got it off the high part of the blade, the ball hung in the sky for ages before coming down in to the safe hands of Kallis at deep midwicket, fourth catch for him today
flatter one on the stumps, clipped away to midwicket, Iqbal goes charging after the ball and fields, end of a very effective spell from Abdulla
tucked away off the back foot through midwicket

no, he cannot, he tries to swing another one straight down the ground, but got this one towards Tendo at long off who had to backpedal furioulsy, and fell over as he took the catch, but well inside the boundary
this is smoked straight down the ground, can Christian pull it off, flighted and he takes full toll, bashes it over the sightscreen

he keeps falling over but keeps getting them off the middle of the bat, it was a high wide full toss outside off, he shuffled, made room initially, then saw it was wide and reached out, falling over but beating extra cover
darted in flat from round the stumps, clipped away through midwicket
misses the mow in to the leg side and takes it on the pads, they take on the keeper with the bye, he hits the stumps but the non-striker makes it in the end
connects this one perfectly, full in the slot, and he swings it high over long on
slower bouncer, he charged down the track and had a heave but missed
falls over in the crease as he squeezes a fuller one to sweeper cover
slower one a length from round the wicket, pushed away towards point

Kallis puts in a brave effort as he comes in charging from deep midwicket, he wanted to swing it over the boundary again, but could not connect cleanly, Kallis came running in but the ball bounced in front of him and hit him on the chin, ouch, he is getting some treatment
slow bouncer that cuts in from outside off, he gets in to a tangle as he looks to pull it away, manages to get it away for a single through square leg
swung away for six over deep midwicket, just stood still and smashed it over the boundary
another short and wide one outside off, cut away in front of point as it comes slowly off the pitch
short, slow, wide outside off stump, he leaps in the air and forehands it away over point
another short one, this one gets up alright, and surprises him as he looks to go for the pull, takes it on the forearm as he swings on one leg
digs in the 'bouncer', but it doesn;t get up even up to waist height, he somehow manages to work it away through square leg
Jacques Kallis is the man, Bhatia digs it in short and he goes for the pull, Kallis is some way in from the boundary, but times the leap perfectly to take a fine catch
straightens and keep very low on middle, he adjusts well to turn it away through square leg
slow offcutter again, he goes down on a knee and swipes it wide of deep midwicket
fuller this time and angled in on the stumps, driven down to long on
just about back of a length and comes off slowly, hit back to the bowler, cannot get it away
yorker length around off, jabbed away to short third man, there is a direct hit at the striker;s but he is in
short outside off, rocks back and cuts away to sweeper cover
turned away down the ground wide of long on
guided in front of point off the front foot who runs to the ball and fires in the throw to the keeper
driven off the front foot with the turn to long off
Duminy charges down the track and swings a flatter one straight to Jacques Kallis at deep midwicket to sink Deccan further in to trouble
goes for the slog on one knee, it turns past the blade and even the keeper fails to stop it cleanly
desperate appeal for lbw, but that struck him outside the line of off
poor delivery, angled down the leg side, Chipli stays in the crease and shovels it fine for a boundary
the slow offcutter from Bhatia, Duminy pushes it in the air towards extra cover where Kallis makes a diving stop
whips a length ball wristily down the ground on the leg side, making the full swing of the bat
gets a boundary this time, makes room and bashes a shortish one wide of long off
angled in to the pads and hits him on the pads as he misses on the flick, going down leg
Chipli bends the knee and drives a fuller one in the air down to long off
widish outside off stump, driven to long off
another fuller one, scythed across the line to deep midwicket
fuller on the pads, flicked away through square leg
cut away, even as one hand comes off the bat handle, to point who is on the edge of the circle
angled wide down the leg side from over the stumps
stays very low as Tendo starts off on a length on middle, pushed down to long on
slower through the air, watchfully defended back to the bowler
slapped away off the front foot to long off
turns ins a long way, from outside off down the leg side, tucked away to short fine leg
Chiplu belts one over deep midwicket, this one was short and he hammered it in to the stands
shuffles and whips this one to midwicket to get off the mark
turns a length ball in to the leg side off the back foot
Sanga has given it away, skips down the track, and chips a fuller one straight to deep square leg, Deccan in trouble
driven back to Bhatia who shows off his football skills, stops the ball with his boot, it loops up and settles in his hands
punched off the back foot and they take the single to long on
length ball on middle and leg, pushed away to long on
a touch quicker outside off, fiercely cut away to backward point
Sanga gets a boundary with a safe pick-up shot, just stood in the crease and lifted it over the bowler, beats long on to the boundary
turned to short fine leg
leaves the crease again, but this time the ball strikes him on the pads, outside off and rolls away backward of point
comes down the track and clips this one away wide of long on
angled in around off and straightening, played back to the bowler
now he goes back and punches to long on
gets under this one angled in on middle and slogs it wide of deep midwicket
played away for a single in front of cover
Bhatia loses his line, and is put away neatly, down the pads and he flicks past short fine leg
comes slowly from back of a length, no pace at all on the ball, punched down to long on
whipped away to deep midwicket off the back foot
slow off cutter from Bhatia, Sanga stays in the crease and turns it in front of square leg
gentle stuff on a length around off, punched to short extra cover
hit away wide of extra cover, and this time the single is taken
gets in to an uncomfortable position as he hits a shortish one to point, Sanga takes off for the single, and then hurries back as the throw comes in
Sanga goes back and punches this length ball in the gap between cover and point
dropped slanted across the right-hander who slaps it in the air to the left of extra cover, who dives but fails to hold on, it is Gautam
122.1 kph outside off stump, guided to point off the back foot
runs in and delivers a length ball with that whippy action, gets an inside edge past the stumps fine on the leg side
Sanga skips down the track, takes this one on the half volley and clips it past mid on, easy on the eye, no violence and four runs taken as well

ugly collision around mid on, Chipli tried to loft YK out of the ground, but got it high in the air towards mid on, Bhatia came charging in from long on for the catch, but Tendo decided it was his ball, and came rushing in faster from mid off, copped a serious blow from the impact, and by the way, no one took that catch, fortunately he is not hurt seriously, and is back on his feet after some treatment
tight stuff from YK, turned away to midwicket
tossed up slowly this time, he pushes it to mid off and they decide against the single
quicker one on the pads, turned to midwicket
drives off the front foot to long off
goes for he cut shot, this one is a touch close outside off, and he chops it in to the ground
one for the album, Sanga goes down on a knee and plays a perfect cover drive, but Morgan is lurking everywhere in the infield
this short ball is right on target, gets big on the batsman who goes for a weak pull and gets it towards midwicket
bouncer from Balaji outside off, left alone

Eoin Morgan didn't get a chance to bat but this is a special piece of work in the field, punched off the back foot to his right at extra cover, he runs hard and stops the boundary, not satisfied with that, he then proceeds to knock down the non-striker;s stumps with a perfect hit, and finds Dhawan miles outside his ground, not bad for a man who dropped a sitter in his previous game
wide one outside off and he slaps it away wide of third man off the front foot
fuller one on the pads, but flicked straight to square leg
he gets going with a fine tickle, it was down the pads, and he nudged it fine in its way
nicely flighted on the stumps, Chipli almost ends up chipping it back to the bowler

hello, he goes for a big pull, this one was not short at all, to his horror it stayed low as well, the end result was he ended up having an ugly heave at it, and the ball skid straight on to brush the pad and crash in to the stumps
charges out and has a wild swipe at a fuller one, gets it wide of deep midwicket
goes for the slog sweep from outside off, misses and Bisla appeals for a stumping, his foot was well inside the line but Deccan need a move on
eventful over from Balaji, the slow short one, he gets an inside edge on to pad as he looks to fend it away, Balaji cannot get to the ball in time to take the catch

Kolkata implore umpire Tarapore fervently for caught behind, it was banged in short and bounced high even as he went for a pull, there was a noise and it lodged in to the keeper's gloves, Tarapore is unmoved
has a huge heave at this one but gets an inside edge towards square leg, they take on Abdulla again with the run, he misses the throw at the striker;s end
gets this one away nicely, swinging in a long way full in to the pads, he stays put and swings it over square leg
looks to smash this one over midwicket, swivels and has a swing, but does not connect
much closer to the batsman this time outside off, cut away to point
120.2 kph shortish and cutting away from outside off, called a wide
tries to flick this one away, but takes it on the thigh pads, good first over for Kolkata

goes back to whip a shortish one away, this is good bowling, it hurries on after pitching, and catches him in the crease, they all go up, but umpire Rudi says no, was there an inside edge? was is too high on the pads?

uh oh, Jaggi wants the run, Dhawan doesn't, it was pushed in the air towards mid on, Abdulla went charging after it and fired in the throw to the keeper, Jaggi rushed back from halfway down the pitch, and the desperate dive seems to have saves him in the end, just saved him, as replays show
turning away, he goes back and plays it away to extra cover
off the inside edge towards midwicket as he pushes forward
fired down the leg side from round the stumps, swept away straight to short fine leg
